title: US maternal mortality rate (deaths per 100,000 live births)

source.name: Maternal Mortality Rates in the United States, 2023 (Health E-Stat 100)
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: NCHS reports the national maternal mortality rate rose sharply during the COVID-19 pandemic, then fell for two straight years to below its 2019 pre-pandemic level: 20.1 (2019), 23.8 (2020), 32.9 (2021), 22.3 (2022), 18.6 (2023) per 100,000 live births.
